summary: Completed the standard-library authentication design for user registration, login, JWT validation, and task ownership.

messages.content: Use users(id, username UNIQUE, password_hash, password_salt, created_at) and associate every task with user_id; do not expose unowned legacy tasks.
Use PBKDF2-HMAC with random salts; issue HS256 JWTs with sub, iat, exp; require Authorization: Bearer tokens and scope all task access by sub.
Keep the returned token in sessionStorage, attach it to task requests, and show the signed-out state after a 401.

decisions: Passwords use salted PBKDF2-HMAC; plaintext passwords are never persisted.
JWTs use base64url-encoded HS256 signatures with constant-time comparison and required sub, iat, and exp claims.
The signing secret is supplied through the server environment and is never hard-coded or returned.
Only registration and login remain public; task routes are authenticated and user-scoped.
